name: Fitness center / gym
summary: Health club with open fitness floor, group-exercise rooms and locker rooms, either ground-up or a converted retail box. Building $/SF is anchored on RSMeans gymnasium/athletic-club models (2019); size and investment anchors come from public company filings (Planet Fitness ~20,000 SF clubs, Life Time ~97,000 SF clubs, Xponential studios ~$554k for 1,500–2,500 SF). Equipment is carried as FF&E. Pools/aquatics are optional line items.

typicalSize.method: e3: HVLP clubs 'typically 20,000 square feet'; e5 boutique studios 1,500–2,500 SF; e4 large athletic clubs ~97,000 SF. Mid 20,000 (most common new-build/conversion size); high 60,000 for full-service clubs.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Freestanding club at ~0.2–0.35 FAR with surface parking (~5–7 spaces per 1,000 SF). Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Health-club zoning commonly 4–8 spaces per 1,000 SF. Derived.

perPrimaryUnit.method: 2025 dollars. RSMeans 2019 building hard cost: gymnasium $177 union / $162 open shop (e1), racquetball/athletic club $172 / $155 (e2); ×~1.30 to 2025 ≈ $200–230/SF plus ~8% on-site work → mid $225 for a new single-story club with locker rooms. Low $90 = interior conversion of an existing retail box (consistent with boutique all-in investment of ≈ $220–370/SF in e5, of which roughly a third to half is leasehold improvements). High $375 = full-service club with extensive locker/spa areas (pools excluded, see lineItems).

scope.notes: Building/interiors + typical on-site work. Excludes fitness equipment (FF&E), pools (lineItem), land, soft costs, off-sites, impact/tap fees.

qualityTiers.method: economy ≈ low/mid (90/225 = 0.4, raised to 0.6 since economy new-builds rarely drop to TI-only cost); luxury = high/mid (375/225); premium interpolated.

systemSplit.method: Derived: locker rooms/showers drive plumbing (22 ≈ 9%) and specialties (10: lockers, partitions); rubber flooring and finishes 09 ≈ 13%; high ventilation/cooling loads 23 ≈ 11%; on-site work ≈ 9%. Not sourced from a published estimate.

lineItems.name: Indoor lap/leisure pool (per SF of water) incl. natatorium HVAC premium

cost.method: Amenities block pool-per-sf: $145–$488 per SF of water (Chico feasibility study, Recreation Management). Natatorium enclosure and dehumidification add further.

lineItems.notes: Qty defaults to 0; set SF of water for full-service clubs.

cost.method: Derived: plumbing-dense rooms at ~1.5–2× the building average; ~8% of club area.

lineItems.name: Group exercise studios (sprung floors, mirrors, AV)

cost.method: Derived premium over base finishes per SF of studio area.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Fitness equipment package (cardio, strength, functional), AV and furniture: ~$400k–$1.0M for a 20,000 SF club. Equipment is replaced every five to nine years (e3). Derived; verify with equipment vendor quotes.

pctOfHard.method: RSMeans model architectural fees ~7% (e1) plus MEP/structural, civil, permits, testing, legal. Franchise fees (e5 franchise systems) are additional. Derived.

softCosts.notes: Franchise systems: add initial franchise fee and pre-opening marketing outside hard/soft.

hard.method: Typical; conversions at the high end.

perPrimaryUnit.method: low 90×1.12 to high 375×1.24; excludes equipment and pools.

source.title: Gymnasium - Commercial Construction Costs Per Square Foot (RSMeans model page)

evidence.quote: Gymnasium with Concrete Block / Rigid Steel ... SubTotal 100% $141.48 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $35.37
evidence.scopeNotes: 2019 RSMeans national model, 20,000 SF, 1 story, union labor. value = subtotal + 25% contractor fees = $176.85/SF; open shop = $162.05/SF. Building only: excludes the architectural fees (6–8%) shown on the page, sitework, FF&E.

source.title: Racquetball Court - Commercial Construction Costs Per Square Foot (RSMeans model page)

evidence.quote: Racquetball Court with Brick Veneer / Rigid Steel ... SubTotal 100% $137.52 ... Contractor Fees (General Conditions,Overhead,Profit) 25% $34.38
evidence.scopeNotes: 2019 RSMeans national model, 30,000 SF, 2 story, union labor. value = subtotal + 25% contractor fees = $171.9/SF; open shop = $155.06/SF. Building only: excludes the architectural fees (6–8%) shown on the page, sitework, FF&E. Closest RSMeans model to a full-service athletic club (courts, lockers).

evidence.scopeNotes: HVLP gym size; equipment replaced 'approximately every five to nine years' (same filing).

evidence.scopeNotes: Upper bound for large-format athletic clubs with pools; used for sizing only.

source.title: Xponential Fitness, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

evidence.quote: Studios are generally designed to be between 1,500 and 2,500 square feet in size, depending on the brand. The smaller box format contributed to a weighted average initial franchisee investment of approximately $554,000 in 2025.
evidence.scopeNotes: Total franchisee initial investment (leasehold improvements, equipment, franchise fee, opening costs) in leased space; ≈ $220–$370/SF all-in for boutique studios. Not hard cost.
